description: Free. Ranks Great Britain's councils on one Market Atlas figure, such as the highest terrace yields in the North East under £150,000 or the fastest price growth in Wales. Each council comes with its median price, terrace yield, rent, five-year growth and page url.

maxPrice.description: Only councils whose median price (propertyType's, when given) is at most this, in pounds.

measure.description: What to rank by: terraceYield (gross yield on a typical terraced house, the default), typeYield (gross yield for propertyType's usual bedrooms), grossYield (all homes), price (median, or propertyType's), rent (average a month, or for propertyType's usual bedrooms), change1y, change5y and change10y (house price index, %), sales (in 12 months), allowanceGap (two-bed housing allowance less the average two-bed rent).

minSales.description: Only councils with at least this many sales in 12 months, 100 by default.

order.description: high puts the highest first, low the lowest. By default the cheapest price, else the highest.

propertyType.description: For typeYield, price, rent and maxPrice: that type of home's figures.

region.description: Only councils in one region or country: an English region ("North East", "Yorkshire and The Humber", "London"), or "England", "Wales" or "Scotland".

name: rank_areas
title: Rank areas
